_about: Maps. Walk off an edge listed in `exits` to travel to that map. `theme` picks ground tiles, ponds, fairy rings and scenery (art ids from art/assets.json); props with `cluster` grow in groups, `sway` ones move in the breeze. `ambience` adds particles (petals | leaves | fireflies | sparkles), butterflies, cloud shadows and a colour tint. Maps with `encounters` have random battles; `music` is a song id from music.json. Building/decor/NPC x,y are tile offsets from the map centre (y up).
